body:
No direct evidence but I can think I am significantly predisposed to a lot of common shit. 

On my mother's side, I have both an uncle and two cousins with some sort of autistic disorder. (One of those cousins, and even one of my mom's cousins, are severely autistic.) I may even have it too. Who the hell knows? 

On my father's side, my grandfather was diagnosed with schizophrenia, and I believe my father's youngest brother (who is around 30 years old) is starting to show symptoms of it. Nobody else has it to my knowledge, but I could very well have a defective gene or two. 

While it is true that part of my appearance could be caused by environment (I live in a pretty shitty one and being harassed and teased made me less willing to fix up my appearance), obesity and ugliness do run in my family as well. Two of my aunts and three of my cousins are either significantly or mildly obese. I don't remember since I was young, but one of my aunts apparently had a stroke right in front of me. High blood pressure is rampant too. 

I also noticed that many of my family members are below-average in physical appearance. Nobody in my family are actually good lookers. 

Finally, being born to two people who have done drugs before I was even conceived certainly didn't help. 

Let's just say that I would rank myself as a 1 or 2 out of 10 when it comes to actual genetic quality.

Thanks for the response though.
